title: Android Boot Diagnostic Report

issues.message: [    1.211000] wlan: Direct firmware load for vendor/wifi/fw.bin failed with error -2
[    1.220000] wlan: probe of 0000:01:00.0 failed with error -2
[    2.011000] audit(0.0:22): avc: denied { read } for comm="vendor_init" name="calibration" scontext=u:r:vendor_init:s0 tcontext=u:object_r:vendor_file:s0 tclass=file

recommendations: Investigate driver probe or initialization failures, including device-tree and hardware configuration.
Check that the required firmware file exists at the expected path and matches the driver and device.
Review the SELinux denial context and add only the policy rule required for the intended access.
Inspect the failing init service or action, its dependencies, and the relevant init .rc configuration.
Profile the slow initialization stages and check whether their work can start later or run in parallel.
